history.summary: Modern temple at Parivar Housing Society on Ausa Road (Malvati Rd), Latur. Its landmark is a 25-foot-tall statue of Lord Hanuman standing on an upper platform. The two-level structure holds the shrine with a smaller Hanuman idol at the lower level; an artificial waterfall drops from the front edge of the upper platform into a pool below, creating a curtain-of-water effect in front of the shrine. The complex includes a landscaped garden and is described as a peaceful place of worship. Builder, trust and founding date are unverified.

name: Shri Virat Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Latur is a city in the Marathwada region of Maharashtra, known as a regional education hub and part of the state's sugar belt. Its landmarks include the 12th-century Siddheshwar Ratneshwar temple complex and the 1917 Ganj Golai market, where 15 streets converge on a central roundabout housing the Devi Jagdamba temple. The district was devastated by the 1993 Killari earthquake, after which much of the city was rebuilt.
